title: NANPA authority for shard-A NPAs 681, 684, 702 and 708

data.notes: Current NANPA material identifies 681 (West Virginia), 684 (U.S. Territory of American Samoa), 702 (Nevada 702/725 overlay) and 708 (Illinois 464/708 overlay) as in-service U.S. NANP geographic NPAs. Each satisfies shard-A rule integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.

title: Morgantown Mutual Aid current first-party hub

data.notes: Current first-party site describes a grassroots Morgantown, West Virginia mutual-aid network providing shared resources, mutual care and direct action; it links public Linktree, Instagram, Facebook and email surfaces and lists Food Not Bombs, Freedom Farmers, Conscious Closet and Stitch Please in its network.

title: Morgantown Food Not Bombs current public hub

data.notes: Current public Linktree exposes Morgantown Food Not Bombs Instagram/Facebook and volunteer surfaces; Morgantown Mutual Aid's current first-party site states FNB serves Saturdays at 4:30 at Monkey Wrench Books and is part of its network.

Current 2026 calendar and first-party page describe Freedom Farmers as a volunteer grassroots organization affiliated with Morgantown Mutual Aid, committed to solidarity and non-hierarchical organizing, maintaining community gardens and guerrilla gardening projects.

title: West Virginia Fights Back current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site describes a West Virginia grassroots movement opposing prison slavery and criminalization of poverty, organizing radical mutual aid and community defense; it publishes a Charleston address, ProtonMail contact and public 681 telephone number.

Current searches across Pago Pago, Tutuila and American Samoa for anarchist, Food Not Bombs, autonomous/collective and grassroots mutual-aid organizations did not mature a qualifying current organization. No historical seed was promoted active.

title: Food Not Bombs Las Vegas current/recent status evidence

data.notes: Current public directory describes Food Not Bombs Las Vegas as a Vegas Valley grassroots mutual-aid network, leaderless and consensus-based, serving free vegan meals and opposing militarization; recent local reporting also references the organization's public Instagram activity.

title: New Leaf Community Las Vegas current/recent status evidence

data.notes: Current-accessible local reporting describes New Leaf Community as a Las Vegas volunteer organization building small mobile homes for unhoused people, distributing food, clothes and resources, and directing the public to newleafcommunity.org.

title: South Suburban Mutual Aid current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site identifies South Suburban Mutual Aid Inc. as a community support and service organization for Chicago's south suburbs, lists food giveaways, economic support and outreach, and publishes info@ssmutualaid.org plus a 708 public phone number.
